newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - SocGen cuts Allied Domecq.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SocGen cuts Allied Domecq.

text.p: Estimates for pre-tax profits at Allied Domecq Plc have been cut by SocGen, analysts at the brokerage said on Friday.
The move comes after the spirits, pubs and fast food group reported full-year pre-tax profits on Tuesday of 575 million stg, down from 645 million stg a year before.
SocGen reduced pre-tax estimates to 610 million stg from 630 million for fiscal 1997 and to 680 million stg from 690 million for the year after.
"We expect expenditure on marketing spirits to increase this year without any serious uplift in sales," said analyst Steven Baird at the brokerage.
Shares in Alied Domecq were down 1/2p at 454-1/2p by 1210 GMT.
